title: Batch Image to Pixel Art Converter | PIXTUDIO
seoDescription: Convert multiple images into pixel art using shared pixelation settings and a reusable palette. Process extracted video frames and download PNG results as a ZIP.
description: Turn extracted video frames into pixel art with one shared recipe. Process a batch of images and download the PNG results as a ZIP.
schemaDescription: Batch image-to-pixel-art conversion with shared grid and palette settings, including workflows using extracted video frames.
heading: BATCH PIXELATION PLUGIN
steps: Export your video as individual image frames using an external tool.
Open one frame in PIXTUDIO Batch Pixelation and adjust the pixelation settings.
Select your frames and apply the reference recipe to the batch.
Download processed PNG images in a ZIP, then assemble them into a video using an external editor.
